title: LeBlanc, Deceiver (errata)
old_text: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].
new_text: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. Then do this: It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].
explanation: Copying another unit and granting Temporary happen in a reflexive trigger after the Reflection is played.
